# San Ramon General Trading & Cont. Co.

> San Ramon General Trading & Cont. Co. (شركة سان ريمون للتجارة العامة والمقاولات) is a Kuwaiti
> trading and contracting company founded in 2004, headquartered in Hawalli, Kuwait
> (P.O.Box 5485, Hawalli 32085, Tunisia St area). It manufactures, imports and distributes
> products across six departments and serves customers B2B and B2C in Kuwait and the wider
> GCC region. Commercial License: 2014/3712.

## Departments and brands

- Oil & Gas (since 2004): imports engineering equipment and spare parts for petrochemical and
  oil companies in Kuwait. Partner brands: Chase (UK), PHE Polymers (US), AST safety valves
  (Italy), Syno Pumps (India), CPI Fluid Engineering / Lubrizol (US), Nuova General Instrument (Italy).
- Products / Food & Beverages (since 2012): owner and main manufacturer of Karak Tea
  (karaktea.com), Shahad Honey, Food Hacks cooking sprays, Food Experts, Najdiya instant Arabic
  coffee, Kif Al Mosafer instant Arabic coffee (ISO prize winner), Finjan Al Arab premium Arabic
  coffee, and Capri Nespresso-compatible capsules. Distribution extends across the GCC.
- Beauty Products (since 2013): Bella Terra Cosmetics mineral makeup and Marshmallows Nail Spa.
- Café & Restaurants (since 2015): Capri coffee (catering and delivery), Kakawna artisan
  chocolate and desserts, Jacket Potato & Hot Dogs (JPH).
- Interior Design (since 2018): Fit Out — commercial and residential interior design and
  construction services for private, public and governmental sectors in Kuwait.

## Clients

Kuwait Oil Company, Kuwait Airways, Qatar Airways, Gulf Bank, Carrefour, LuLu Hypermarket,
Sultan Market, Grand Hyper, City Hyper Market, oncost, Ramez, talabat mart, Trolley,
That Al Salasil, Alyasra Foods, Alnasser, Alsaeedah, Cinescape, Sky Cinemas, Seazen Group,
Gardens Coffee, Aseer Time, Healthy Life, Olive, Aastha Enterprises.
